notes.title: Starship Empire Server updated to prevent frequent crashes
notes.content: Since the Beta/Preview started the Game Server has been up and down due to frequent crashes.  With this update the server should be more stable.  Equip your starship and get ready to blow the enemy out of the skies!

notes.title: Starship Empire Beta Updates!
notes.content:
The first couple of beta sessions proved very useful.  Initial feedback has found 35+ bugs and feature requests.  I've tried to take care of some of the low-hanging fruit, but also added the following player-requested features:
[list]
[*]Safe Zones around each ally Starbase
[*]Equip your Ship from within the Starbase
[*]Mine weapons and other items from Ship debris
[*]Better balancing of selling items to Starbase vs buying more missiles
[/list]

If you are looking to be part of the closed-beta, watch my dev stream at [url=https://twitch.tv/bjcampolo]https://twitch.tv/bjcampolo[/url], Mondays and Wednesdays at 8-10pm ET.  Click Follow and use your Channel Reward points on the item named Starship Empire Beta Steam Key.

notes.title: Starship Empire Playtest/Beta Steam Keys are in!
notes.content: Good news!!!  Steam has approved my playtest/beta build and the Steam keys are in!  To request a key, watch my dev stream at [url=https://twitch.tv/bjcampolo]https://twitch.tv/bjcampolo[/url], Mondays and Wednesdays at 8-10pm ET.  Click Follow and use your Channel Reward points on the item named Starship Empire Beta Steam Key.

notes.title: Starship Empire Invite-Only Beta Starting Soon!
notes.content: I'm getting close to publishing an invite-only beta version of Starship Empire.  Be on the look out for instructions on how to gain access to the beta.
